headline: Impact of Iran-US Tensions: Blocking Strait of Hormuz on Oil, LNG
summary: Tensions between Iran and the United States have spotlighted the Strait of Hormuz, a key corridor for global oil and gas trade. Military buildup in the region has raised concerns about a potential closure.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical oil chokepoint, linking Gulf producers to global markets. Any disruption can quickly lift crude and LNG prices.
why_moved: Concerns about a possible closure of a major oil and LNG chokepoint raise supply-risk premiums in energy prices.
